name: Varun Grover || Comedy Special || Nothing Makes Sense
description:
My first ever standup special - NOTHING MAKES SENSE - out on youtube now.

I toured with it in 2024-2025 and had great fun developing it. Thanks to everyone who attended a live show of this special.

My all-new 90-mins solo LOVE, DEATH, and KETCHUP is touring now. Dubai, India, Europe, and UK - all
